title: Complete lower-screen Adventure and Battle spellbook
summary: Open the native book from lower Adventure Actions or existing Battle Cast Spell. Browse known spells by category, native/custom school and level; inspect bounded complete details and mana costs; Cast through the original native selection and targeting route, or Close.
preparation: Verify the exact candidate receipt, package is.xyz.vcmi.thor and APK SHA-256; install preserving data. Prepare disposable Adventure and Battle saves with known spells of different levels/schools, targeted and untargeted spells, enough and insufficient mana, plus special/custom-school and long/localized text cases if available. Record unavailable cases explicitly.
limitations: Targets, multi-target selection, native confirmations and errors remain upper-screen native controls. Casting may close the book; cancel targeting and reopen using normal native behavior. Callback-based external spell selectors retain their native UI. Books over 256 rows/32 schools fail closed. Only player-known native book/search results are published; details are bounded to 4096 UTF-8 bytes. No spell, save, server or primary-input rules change.

checks.title: Adventure entry and complete browsing
checks.steps: Select a hero with and without a spellbook; use lower Adventure Actions Spellbook. Check disabled entry while moving, blocked or off turn. Browse Adventure/Battle, All/native/custom schools and levels 0–5, including empty results. Use every list page, inspect spells, page through long/localized details and return to the list. Change the upper native search.
checks.expected: Entry follows the original native shortcut and selected hero. Only known/native search results appear with the correct hero, mana, levels, costs and proficiency descriptions/damage. Every bounded result and description is reachable; filters/pages are disjoint, readable and local. Unsupported selectors retain native UI.

checks.title: Adventure casting, errors and targeting
checks.steps: Cast one legal untargeted and one targeted Adventure spell from lower details. Choose a legal target on the upper map; cancel targeting in another trial and reopen the book. Test insufficient mana, inappropriate location, Town-open inspection and turn/hero changes. Close the book from below.
checks.expected: Cast enables only for the current native eligible spell and executes at most once through the normal native route. Mana/game state and native errors/confirmations are unchanged. Targeting uses upper controls; cancellation, reopening and Close preserve normal owner restoration. Battle spells remain inspectable but cannot cast from Adventure.

checks.title: Battle spellbook and casting round trips
checks.steps: Open the book through existing lower Battle Cast Spell. Browse and cast targeted, untargeted and multi-target spells where available, use upper targets/confirmations, and cancel targeting. Check mana, spell-per-turn restrictions, opponent turns, spectator state and changes of active hero. Browse Adventure spells from this book.
checks.expected: The exact current Battle hero and turn own casting. Native eligibility and spell-per-turn restrictions apply, and lower Cast cannot target another hero or an opposite-category spell. Existing Battle targeting/cancellation, Wait/Defend and result dismissal restore the normal current deck without stale spell controls.

checks.title: Stale releases and pending recovery
checks.steps: Hold Cast/Open/Close or a filter/row while changing upper context, hero, book/search, mana or turn. Rapidly repeat releases, drag off controls, add/remove a second pointer, and cancel gestures. Cover the book with native dialogs then dismiss them.
checks.expected: Only one current pointer/revision/session request executes; old rows and releases cannot cast, reopen or close another window. Disabled/pending states recover after refreshed native state. Modal transitions withdraw the lower book and restore current data without residual content.

checks.title: Display and activity lifecycle
checks.steps: While browsing details and while targeting or a native dialog is open, resize/recreate the lower presentation, toggle/reconnect the lower display and background/resume. Reopen with the same and a different hero.
checks.expected: Held inputs cancel; one current presentation returns with matching-revision immutable data. Navigation retention/clamping is correct for live same-Hero refreshes and resets for Hero/context changes. No duplicate action, stuck pending state, focus loss, stale hit region or update loop occurs.

checks.title: Neighboring decks and upper/single-display input
checks.steps: Recheck the nine Adventure Actions and Heroes/Towns/Map tabs, Hero management/Meeting, Town Army/services, Mage Guild, Blacksmith, Tavern, market and recruitment, Battle/tactics/results. Use upper touch/controller with lower display enabled and disabled.
checks.expected: Original commands, owner lifecycle, gameplay and upper input/focus remain normal. The new Adventure layout is readable and touchable, existing commands remain reachable, and single-display/native spellbook behavior is preserved without crashes.
